met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over Southeast Pakistan & neighbourhood lies over Saurashtra & adjoining Northeast Arabian Sea at 0530 hrs IST of today 16th September, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 9.4 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through centre of Low Pressure Area over Saurashtra & adjoining Northeast Arabian Sea, Deesa, Guna, Satna, Daltonganj, Jamshedpur, Digha, and thence southeastwards to Northwest Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Odisha and adjoining north Andhra Pradesh and Northwest Bay of Bengal now lies over Northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining north coastal Odisha at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over central Assam & neighbourhood and extendsupto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over south Coastal Andhra Pradesh & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from South interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu persists and now seen at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Bihar to North Odisha across Jharkhand between 1.5 to 4.5 km above mean level has become less marked.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation over Jammu & neighbourhoodat 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
